Check each dataset against its sources (see [DATA.md](https://github.com/chmuzamil/pakdatakit/blob/main/DATA.md)) and update `dataVersion` if anything changes.

- [ ] **Districts**: new or split districts notified in any province (provincial gazettes, Dawn, APP)
- [ ] **Banks**: new digital banks or wallets issuing IBANs, mergers or renames (SBP press releases); confirm each new code with a real published IBAN
- [ ] **Mobile prefixes**: new `03XX` allocations (PTA, operator announcements)
- [ ] **Holidays**: add this year's observed Eid, Ashura and Milad dates after each Cabinet Division notification
- [ ] **Raast QR**: any change in the QR format banking apps generate
- [ ] Open data-correction issues reviewed

Close this issue when done, even if nothing changed.
